senses.gloss: मेखला f. 1. A belt, a girdle, रत्नानुविद्धार्णवमेखलाया दिशः स्पत्नी भव दक्षिणस्याः R.vi.63; 2. the zone of a woman, असमाप्य विलासमेखलां किमिदं किन्नरकंठि सुप्यते R.viii.64, Rt.i.4; 3. the triple cord worn by the first three castes; 4. a sword-belt; 5. the girth of a horse; 6. the slope of a mountain, रघुपतिपदैरंकितं मेखलासु Megh.i.12; 7. the hips; 8. an epithet of the river Narmadā.
मेखला-बंध m. investiture with the girdle.
मेखलिन् m. 1. An epithet of Śiva; 2. a Brahmachārin q.v.
